title: Byte-pair encoding from scratch
hints: Work on list(text.encode('utf-8')). Count adjacent pairs with zip(ids, ids[1:]) and a Counter; every overlapping occurrence counts.
min(counts, key=lambda p: (-counts[p], p)) picks the most frequent pair with the lexicographic tie-break in one line.

Merging is one left-to-right pass with an index that jumps by 2 on a match and by 1 otherwise. encode is that same pass applied once per merge, in training order, and the decoding vocab is vocab[256 + i] = vocab[a] + vocab[b].
